geeklist.title: Thinning the herd
geeklist.description:
1. All games will have a minimum starting bid (SB).
2. All bids must be in whole US dollars (please include your zipcode with your bids to make it easier to get a shipping quote when the auction ends).
3. Shipping is from 93308 (Bakersfield, CA) and will be paid by the winner - I use Pirate Ship for the most competitive rates. I always include tracking information to protect both buyer and seller. Local pick up is perfectly fine with me.
4. US Shipping only. Sorry international backers, but costs would be prohibitive.
5. All transactions will be done via PayPal.
6. BGG will take a 3% cut of each transaction.
7. Item condition is good to very good unless otherwise noted in the description.
8. If you have a question about the version/condition of any of the items in this auction, please comment on the auction itself rather than the item. If you have any concerns about the auction, please send me a Geekmail. I'd like the comments for each item to be bids only.
9. This particular auction will run until sometime in the evening of Sunday, February 1st, 2026. I have a set end time in mind for the listings, but I want to discourage sniping and keep it friendly!
10. Games are listed in multiple places, so I reserve the right to pull any items from the auction that may sell via other means at any point.
That's it - happy bidding, and thanks for your interest!
